<thought>To obtain the precursors, I will first search the template catalog for a Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons (HWE) reaction template using criteria that match the forward reaction: it forms an aliphatic carboxylic acid and a C‑C double bond, and breaks a C‑P bond and a C‑O bond. Once I have the template ID, I will apply that template to each of the three target SMILES provided in the previous answer, collecting all precursor sets. Finally, I will format the result as a list of lists of SMILES strings.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-P bond", "C-O bond"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid", "C-C double bond"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C=C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-P", "C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
